verdict.rationale: Nix's documented CLI lets an agent fetch and install project dependencies via `nix-shell`/`nix develop`, upgrade packages with `nix-env --upgrade`, and run commands non-interactively with `nix-shell --run`. Atomic operations and rollback make failed updates safe. However, nothing in the pack documents exit-code semantics or structured error output, and a hands-on user reports that when something fails you have to dig deep to fix errors, which undercuts the 'clear errors' part of the story. Missing for 10: documented exit codes, clear or machine-readable error reporting, an explicit non-interactive/flake lock-update workflow for dependencies, and independent evidence of agent-driven use.
